description: Work out what generating an email, a PDF, a Substack post or a document would use, rendering nothing and spending no draft or credit. Give it the kind and whatever the user has said so far; it answers with the template it would use and that template's fields with their defaults, which required fields are still missing, the brand kit it would resolve to and the other kits with their ids, the page, orientation and footer a PDF would take from the kit, the templates the user has saved, the free drafts left, the unlock cost, and ready. Call it once before generate_email or generate_pdf, then generate in the same turn unless one open choice would change the result.

align.description: The text alignment, if they asked.

appearance.description: Light or dark, if they asked.

footer_text.description: The PDF footer line, if they gave one.

header.description: The email header style, if they asked.

markdown.description: The body, if they gave one.

page.description: The PDF page size, if they named one.

page_numbers.description: PDF page numbers, if they asked.

props.description: Template text fields the user gave, all strings.

saved_template_id.description: A saved_template_id from list_templates; its inputs seed the ones you pass.

subject.description: The email subject, if they gave one.

template_id.description: The template the user named, if any.

title.description: The PDF title, if they gave one.

name: plan_generation
